hazards.text: Contains a lithium-ion battery: fire risk if punctured or crushed.
Screens made before about 2009 use fluorescent backlights that contain mercury. Do not break or crush the screen.

dispose: Remove and wipe the drive first.
Take the battery out if you can.
Do not put it in household trash.
Take it to an e-waste recycler or a retailer take-back program.

hazards.text: Holds personal data: wipe or physically destroy it before recycling.

dispose: Wipe or destroy the data first.
Do not put it in household trash.
Take it to an e-waste recycler or a retailer take-back program.
salvage: The whole drive, if it works (wipe it first)

dispose: Reuse it if it still works.
Do not put it in household trash.
Take it to an e-waste recycler or a retailer take-back program.
salvage: The whole module, if it fits your other machines

hazards.text: Remove ink and toner cartridges first. Toner is a fine powder: do not spill or inhale it.

dispose: Do not put it in household trash.
Take it to an e-waste recycler or a retailer take-back program.
